spec.baseline: Trial 1 raw Peter baseline (mult=0.40, unconditioned, return=-21.34%, Max DD=35.92%).

evaluation.plan: Purged chronological evaluation on 18-month development dataset. Holdout period (H2 2025) remains unread until final confirmation.

spec.falsifier: Reject the thesis if: 1. Net annualized Sharpe ratio fails to achieve positive value on development data. 2. Maximum drawdown exceeds 20.0%. 3. Profit factor is less than 1.05 after commissions and slippage. 4. Number of profitable calendar quarters is fewer than 4 of 6.
spec.mechanism:
1. Volatility Regime Expansion: Days with high volatility rank exhibit strong directional
   expansion (Spearman Rank IC = 0.195, p < 1e-10), allowing breakout entries to survive.
2. Noise Suppression: Suppressing trades when vol_rank < 0.25 prunes mean-reverting morning
   chop that hits stops at the open.
3. Continuous Risk Scaling: Position risk is scaled continuously by regime rank, adhering
   to ml4t-regime-awareness without binary market-timing fragility.
spec.thesis: Conditioning intraday volatility breakout entries on lagged 120-day volatility percentile rank (vol_rank >= 0.25) with continuous risk scaling prevents false breakout whipsaws during low-volatility regimes and preserves positive net expectancy after transaction costs.

trials.description: Regime-gated breakout at 0.40 * ATR(5), suppressing trades when prior_vol_rank < 0.25, with continuous risk scaling (0.5x to 1.5x of 0.33%).
Regime-gated breakout with wider 0.50 * ATR(5) band and continuous risk scaling.
Adaptive multi-tier regime execution: Skip when vol_rank < 0.20; 0.55*ATR with 0.6x risk in moderate vol (0.20-0.50); 0.40*ATR with 1.0x risk in expansion vol (>= 0.50).
